paper_title: Breaking Bias, Building Bridges Evaluation and Mitigation of Social   Biases in LLMs via Contact Hypothesis
caption: Lighter shaded bars show the percentage of prompts that generate biased responses before instruction tuning, whereas darker shaded bars correspond to the same after instruction tuning. Darker bars begin at the top of the lighter bars (for example, for the first bar, the lighter bar is 39.50%, and the darker bar is only 0.04%). Takeaway: Instruction-tuning on certain key principles eliminates bias to nearly zero (visualized by the absence of dark bars) across prompts specific to Support of Authorities and Extended Contact, also considerably reducing bias across Virtual Contact prompts.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage associated with different types of contact under categories labeled "Support of Authorities", "Extended Contact", and "Virtual Contact". The horizontal axis contains the categories, while the vertical axis represents the "Bias Percentage", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10 units. The chart consists of grouped bars, each further divided into individual segments. The segments are color-coded according to a legend: light gray for "No Contact Before," light red for "Positive Contact Before," light blue for "Negative Contact Before," and three striped patterns of matching colors for "No Contact After", "Positive Contact After", and "Negative Contact After". In the "Support of Authorities" category, the bars are approximately 39.5 (gray),31.83 (red), and 42.38 (blue) with 0.04 (striped grey). In the "Extended Contact" category, the bars measure around 40.61 (gray), 36.13 (red), 47.28 (blue), and 0.11 for "Negative Contact After". For "Virtual Contact," the bars are approximately 39.74 (gray), 39.17 (red), with a final stacked pattern showing 43.83 (blue with stripes) and other values around 10 for striped patterns, indicating after-contact measurements. There does not seem to be any specific sorting order, and no bars are visually emphasized apart from the distinct colors and patterns for categorizing data. There is a legend box available at the bottom of the plot to match the bar styles to their labels.
